notes: Captured from the live WHO Disease Outbreak News OData endpoint with the adapter's own query ($orderby=PublicationDateAndTime desc, $top=60, $select of the eleven fields used). All 60 items and the envelope are real and complete except that each Summary longer than 600 characters was cut at a word boundary at or below 600 characters (the adapter stores at most a 400-character excerpt; WHO text is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO, so the fixture keeps no more of it than the tests need). The malformed variant was authored by hand from the same schema.
